How to use cofad? See README for a short introduction.

Bugtracker: https://github.com/johannes-titz/cofad/issues

Example data set (Table 5.3 from Rosenthal and Rosnow, 2000): https://cofad.titz.science/example

Important notice: Your data must be in long format (also called narrow or tidy format). See this short explanation.

Citation: If you use cofad, please cite Henninger, Malejka, and Titz (2025), the current tutorial, and Titz and Burkhardt (2021), the JOSS software paper.
